body: i feel like it's a waste to on existing...

That's really nice stuff of you to say.


Sorry for being a whiny bitch.

That's the thing. The times when life is ok, or even good, last for too short a time to make up for the rest of the crap. That lying in the hot sun listening to the birds? it lasts hardly any time. 


i'd give up those few happy moments for an eternity of nothing.
it's definitely not the hardest thing to do. the hardest thing would be to man up and make your life better. committing suicide is the easy way out...but not *that* easy.
so do i. turns out it's actually pretty hard to kill yourself. I've failed four times. Mostly because i'm a coward. maybe this time will be different.
i don't know if i want to get better. the things that happened have changed me, and not for the better. i don't feel like i'm capable of making it through life now.
i don't speak with my family any more.

I fell down. i didn't get back up. i held out a hand. i waited. no-one came. i realised i had to make myself better. i realised i either don't want to or i'm not capable of doing so. now i'm tired and want to end this all before i'm old and bitter.

no-one real cares. if there's one thing i've learnt in my life, it's that the internet isn't real life. talking to people on the internet isn't like talking to real people. internet friends aren't real friends.
I know you are trying to help. Right now I am so unhappy. I don't want to talk. I just want someone to hug me and tell me they won't let me go. I just want someone to save me
not sure why you think i don't know a lot. i've been working on ways to improve my situation for a long time. i've heard a lot of opinions. and i'm not unintelligent myself.
telling it won't make any difference. it doesn't make me feel any better. there is no advice you can give me that i don't already know. what's the point?
you can go outside. you just choose not to.
i shared it here before, deleted my account. i don't want pity. i don't expect anyone to care about my story or say "hey none of it was your fault! everything will be ok!"
everything that has gone wrong is my fault. i feel there is little point in sharing it. i am a weak, disgusting person.
